text: Operation modes: keep or retire? The setting promptBooster.operationMode has three values (manual, realtime, file), but no code selects a strategy by it. IModeStrategy.canHandle is never called by product code, and FileModeStrategy.execute (generate a .prompt.md file from chat input in file mode) has no caller. With simplifiedContextMode on by default, chat always uses realtime and the editor always uses manual boost, so the setting only decides whether the Process Prompt File code lens and title button show. Should we (a) wire a real mode dispatcher and file generation from chat input, or (b) retire operationMode, switchMode, autoOptimize and the unused ProcessButton status bar class? No change exists for this until you decide.
